adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces case-sensitive email equality checks that can lead to incorrect behavior. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, attendee permission is determined via `booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email)`, which will fail if the same email differs only by case, potentially causing a false FORBIDDEN. In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (`email-manager.ts`), `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` is also case-sensitive; since `newGuests` comes from raw input (`guests`) and `attendee.email` comes from stored/normalized values, casing mismatches can misclassify an attendee as “new” vs “existing”, resulting in the wrong email template being sent.
